findings.finding: The publisher identifies a five-piece original quartet, composed in 2025 and premiered in November 2025 at University of Louisville; it names collaborators who brought it to life. Cached publisher preview includes an image explicitly titled SCORE-and-PARTS.

Publisher offers the complete named original concert work as a purchasable edition, rather than a preview-only product. Four double basses form a complete version without another required instrument; massed doubling is optional.

Inspected Double Bass 1 opening Baile Rustico: treble-clef upper register, alternating 6/8 and 3/4, slurred eighth-note lines and offbeat pizzicato. Publisher describes additional 7/8 and mixed-meter movements; advanced register and coordinated meter changes set the floor. Sample is a part, not the score previously claimed.
